topic: Campaign data update and metric calculation
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on updating campaign data metrics. Initially, [p10] asked if they could use the current stage data (after recalculation by someone) to update saved campaign metrics specifically on the staging environment. [p6] questioned whether campaigns should be treated differently between staging and production environments. [me] clarified that the goal was only to view the list of campaigns, not necessarily updating the entire dataset.

[p5] suggested that recalculation is possible, but the resulting metrics would also save to production, as the metric calculation task accepts a dataset. Ultimately, [p10] decided against proceeding with the update after realizing it affects the production environment.
decisions: Do not proceed with updating campaign metrics using staging data due to potential impact on the production environment.
